meta.title: AI Job Application Copilot
meta.description: Analyze jobs, tailor resumes, generate cover letters, and score application fit.

footer.tagline: Human-in-the-loop · No fabricated experience · Approval required before submit

login.subtitle: Sign in with your Google account to save applications and view your history.
login.privacy: We only use your Google profile to identify your account. No posts or emails are sent.

applications.title: My Applications
applications.subtitle: Track jobs you've analyzed and applied to.

errors.signInToSave: Please sign in to save your application
errors.invalidFileType: Only PDF, DOC, and DOCX formats are supported

job.title: Analyze job description
job.subtitle: Paste a job URL to auto-fill company, title, and description (LinkedIn, Indeed, company career pages, etc.), or fill in manually and analyze.
job.importHint: Some sites require login or block scraping; if import fails, paste the job description directly.

tailor.title: Upload resume & tailor
tailor.subtitle: Upload a PDF or Word resume (.pdf / .doc / .docx). The system will parse it and optimize for ATS against this job.
tailor.signInPrompt: Sign in with your Google account to save your resume and application history.
tailor.completeJobFirst: Complete job analysis in the Job step first.
tailor.uploadPrompt: Click or drag to upload resume
tailor.optionalHint: Tailoring is optional. You can save this application in the Match step without accepting any resume changes.
tailor.completeJobStep: Please complete job analysis in the Job step first.

match.title: Match score
match.subtitle: Save this job to track your application. Resume tailoring is optional — you can save with just the job, or include match scoring if you uploaded a resume.
match.signInPrompt: Sign in to save this application to your history.
match.saved: Application saved. View it in My Applications.
match.completeJobFirst: Complete job analysis in the Job step first.
